Published patterns that the wgh_like preset is set to resemble

Source: R/sim-tools.R
wgh_targets.Rd

Each row is one pattern from a published paper of the child growth research program, with the published value, an acceptable band and its source. The bands are deliberately generous: the simulated cohort is meant to resemble the published results, so that analyses give similar tables and figures, not to reproduce them.

Usage

wgh_targets

Format

A tibble with columns target, sex, published, lower, upper, unit, source and tuned (whether the target was used when setting the preset, or kept out as an independent check).

Source

Ho et al. (2026, Sci Rep 16:7515), Ho et al. (2026, medRxiv 2026.07.26.26358982), Ho et al. (2026, medRxiv 2026.07.26.26358986), Ho (2026, medRxiv 2026.09.08.26362487) and Ho (2026, medRxiv 2026.09.05.26362315). Full citations: wgh_references().

Examples

head(wgh_targets)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 8
#>   target                          sex   published lower upper unit  source tuned
#>   <chr>                           <chr>     <dbl> <dbl> <dbl> <chr> <chr>  <lgl>
#> 1 Visits at largest site (%)      All        67.6    55    75 %     Ho et… TRUE 
#> 2 Visits at smallest site (%)     All         7.4     4    14 %     Ho et… TRUE 
#> 3 Visits under 5 years (%)        All        22.7    15    30 %     Ho et… TRUE 
#> 4 Visits at ages 5 to 11 (%)      All        48.6    38    58 %     Ho et… TRUE 
#> 5 Visits in first year (%)        All         3.4     1     8 %     Ho et… TRUE 
#> 6 Overweight or obesity, 5 to 18… Male       47.7    42    53 %     Ho et… TRUE 
table(wgh_targets$source)
#> 
#>        Ho 2026, medRxiv 2026.09.05.26362315 
#>                                           1 
#>        Ho 2026, medRxiv 2026.09.08.26362487 
#>                                           4 
#>             Ho et al. 2026, Sci Rep 16:7515 
#>                                          17 
#> Ho et al. 2026, medRxiv 2026.07.26.26358982 
#>                                           2 
#> Ho et al. 2026, medRxiv 2026.07.26.26358986 
#>                                           8
